# 3d-capsule-hub

<!-- Generated by `iig3d.py docs` from catalogue/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Member of the 3D corporate family. Central disc, pill capsules with rimmed circles, thin connectors, rimmed capsule wheel. Backdrop: White. Items: 4 to 8. Default aspect: landscape.

## Colour palette

- Hub disc white face with a two-colour or grey rim; capsules white with a thin grey outline; each capsule's circle rim in one family colour
- Rimmed wheel variant (ref-05): the capsule outline itself takes the item colour, doubled as a thick rim on the icon circle, and the hub ring carries short thick connector stubs in blue
- Segment ring variant: analogous colours stepping around the ring (teal to green) or the full family cycle
- White or pale studio backdrop, optional faint orbit rings around the hub

## Visual elements

- Hub disc 20 to 28 percent of the shorter canvas side, bevelled, with the title inside
- Capsules: rounded pill outlines, rimmed circle at the inner end, text filling the rest
- Connectors: thin charcoal lines with a coloured dot where they meet the hub and a plain dot at the capsule
- Segment ring: wedges with visible depth stepping forward, numerals on the wedges, icons inside
- Flat icons in white on the coloured circles

## Typography

- Family typography; title inside the hub in bold caps, capsule names bold caps in the item colour, descriptions light charcoal

## Composition rules

- Hub centred; capsules in two columns (landscape) or around the hub in a ring (square)
- Four to eight capsules; more than eight, switch to 3d-paper-tile
- Connectors never cross; order capsules so lines fan out cleanly
- Segment ring: four to eight wedges, labels outside the ring

## Layout

### Structure

- Hub disc centred, 20 to 28 percent of the shorter canvas side
- Concentric rings on the hub face for layered hubs
- Capsules in two columns (landscape) or in a ring (square)
- Connectors from each capsule to the hub, never crossing
- Optional orbit ring around the hub for a cross-cutting item

### Variants

| Variant | Focus | Visual Emphasis |
|---------|-------|-----------------|
| **Capsule hub** | Inputs and outputs around one platform | Capsule columns left and right |
| **Segment ring** | Cycles | Wedges surround the hub directly |
| **Hub with ribbon** | Hub feeding a sequence | Serpentine ribbon of small discs |
| **Rimmed wheel** | Peer topics, no hierarchy | Capsule outline and circle rim share the item colour, thick connector stubs on the hub |
| **Capsule hierarchy** | Three-level structures, one platform with capabilities and sub-capabilities | Two or three small colour-filled sub-capsules fan out from each capsule's outer end |

### Visual Elements

- Hub disc bevelled with a glossy white face plate
- Capsules: white pills with a thin outline, rimmed circle at the inner end
- Connectors thin and dark with a coloured dot terminal at the hub end matching the capsule rim
- Circle faces plain colour or a simple white line icon
- Small tab under the hub for a supporting tool

### Text Placement

- Title at top
- Hub label on the inner disc
- Capsule name filling the pill body
- Connector labels along the connector line
- Orbit ring label on the ring

- Capability and stakeholder maps
- Source-to-consumer pictures around one platform
